name: bobs-books-api
description: Two read-only tools for Bob's Used Books

toolOverrides.name: ListBooks
toolOverrides.description: List books for sale in Bob's Used Books. Returns title, author, condition (Hardcover/Paperback), genre and price for each book. Call this first when the user asks what is available or wants recommendations.

toolOverrides.name: GetBook
toolOverrides.description: Get one book by its id, including title, author, condition, genre, price and quantity. Use the id from ListBooks.
